findingDetails.title: Phase 2 changed-file table names a file that never changed
findingDetails.claim: The table says mcp-figma/manual-testing-playbook/figma-to-code/node-to-token-markup.md was modified to point at the frontend reference, but the file is byte-identical to baseline 10474a9567 and contains no fundamentals or frontend reference.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Compared every row in all three implementation summaries against git status; only this row and the deleted folder row (which git expands per file) fail the check.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The packet may have intended a rename or a later edit that was reverted; either way the summary's recorded state is false.
findingDetails.scopeProof: git diff --stat for the path prints nothing and grep for fundamentals or web-visual-values in the file prints no line.

findingDetails.title: Phase 1 routing criterion mixes a five-prompt baseline with an eight-prompt replay
findingDetails.claim: AC-005 says five baseline value prompts while its verification cell claims all eight value, review and motion prompts, and the packet never lists the eight.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the phase docs for a list of the eight prompts; none is recorded. Replayed the five baseline prompts and all five route to sk-code-frontend.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The five may be a subset of the eight and the row may be intentionally broad; it is still not reproducible from the packet.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: None at P2; it would be P1 only if a named prompt in the set failed the replay.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The two counts appear only in the AC row and the phase summary; the replay output is not recorded per prompt.
